verdicts.quote: Pain on the outside of the knee on downhills is often the IT band getting cranky, so a few minutes with a foam roller on the outer thigh before runs might take the edge off.
verdicts.why: Names a likely condition (IT band) and recommends a treatment (foam roller) for reported knee pain.
No weight, body, or appearance content; avoid_weight_talk is false and weight is null.
